verdict.rationale: mise explicitly targets asdf switchers by reading .tool-versions files as-is and even reusing asdf plugins, letting users keep incumbent config/commands while migrating; community confirms it works well as a 'drop-in asdf replacement' with better UX. missing for 10: no evidence of compatibility shims for other incumbent tools (nvm/pyenv/rbenv command syntax) beyond asdf, and no independent report specifically testing command-for-command parity beyond drop-in replacement anecdotes.
